definitions.explanation: Used to count bound publications such as books, magazines, notebooks, and other bound volumes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三冊|さんさつ}→三冊：noentry⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何冊|なんさつ}→何冊：08778_nansatsu⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{五冊|ごさつ}→五冊：noentry⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can borrow five books at the library.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{二冊|にさつ}→二冊：noentry⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ようにしています→ようにする：10987_younisuru⟧。
examples.english: I try to read about two books every month.

notes:
〜{冊|さつ} is the counter for bound volumes like books, magazines, and notebooks.

WHAT IT COUNTS:
- ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧: books
- ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧: magazines
- ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧: notebooks
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧: dictionaries

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧: 1 book (sound change: っさつ)
- ⟦{二冊|にさつ}→二冊：noentry⟧: 2 books
- ⟦{三冊|さんさつ}→三冊：noentry⟧: 3 books
- ⟦{四冊|よんさつ}→四冊：noentry⟧: 4 books
- ⟦{五冊|ごさつ}→五冊：noentry⟧: 5 books
- ⟦{六冊|ろくさつ}→六冊：noentry⟧: 6 books
- ⟦{七冊|ななさつ}→七冊：noentry⟧: 7 books
- ⟦{八冊|はっさつ}→八冊：noentry⟧: 8 books (sound change: っさつ)
- ⟦{九冊|きゅうさつ}→九冊：noentry⟧: 9 books
- ⟦{十冊|じゅっさつ}→十冊：noentry⟧: 10 books (sound change: っさつ)
- ⟦{何冊|なんさつ}→何冊：08778_nansatsu⟧: how many books?

{十冊|じゅっさつ} is also read {十冊|じっさつ}; both are correct, and じゅっさつ is the more common spoken form.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦〜{本|ほん}→〜本：00688_hon⟧ counts long cylindrical objects. The trap is the word ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧ itself: a book is counted with 〜{冊|さつ}, never with 〜{本|ほん}, even though the two are written with the same character.
- ⟦〜{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ counts the paper before it is bound. Loose printouts are ⟦{三枚|さんまい}→三枚：noentry⟧; the same pages stapled into a booklet become ⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧.
- What matters is binding, not content or thickness: even a thin ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧ is ⟦{一冊|いっさつ}→一冊：23149_issatsu⟧, while a ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧, which is only folded, is counted with 〜⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ instead.
